crop.notes: The whole 'General Sporting Notes' column (rowing, horses, wrestling, quail); only the last paragraph, on the benefit for 'Gaffer' Johnson, mentions Allen.

ocr.notes: Gist readable but many character errors ('Tem Alien' for 'Tom Allen', 'Jobn-on, an old ime oe sporting nomin' for 'Johnson, an old time English sporting man').

title.suggested: Tom Kelly to Spar at Benefit, First Time Since Allen Set-To

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported that Tom Kelly would spar Fred Zacritz at a benefit for 'Gaffer' Johnson, his first public appearance since his memorable set-to with Tom Allen at the old Theatre Comique.

metadata.notes: Masthead: 'The Republican: St. Louis, Sunday Morning, December 17, 1882', page 13. Filed as the Missouri Republican (St. Louis Republic only from 1888).

facts.fact: Allen had a memorable set-to with Tom Kelly at the old Theatre Comique in St. Louis some years before 1882

notes: Date of the Allen-Kelly set-to not given ('some years ago').
